customerOutcome: Correct one current Native draft step without rebuilding the workflow or changing its active revision.
entryConditions: Current authenticated principal and company selection; no retained foreign-principal payload
Effective feature admission is required for new work; native membership and resource authority remain necessary
exitConditions: Only a canonical server-confirmed result permits a success claim
Pending, stale, unavailable or unqualified work never becomes successful or activated

content.supportingCopy: Changes are saved to the draft. Test and review it before publishing.
displayedState: Exact current draft/revision/update identity and selected Native node
Full current node name; complete supported wait/approval or round-trippable guided condition comparison. Unknown configurations remain Advanced.
Other configuration stays with the selected Native Advanced editor; name-only edits preserve inputs, retries, conditions, branches and private config
Original own-request save receipt is historical; publication and execution remain separate

inputs: Approval summary up to 1000 and consequence up to 2000 readable characters
Guided condition source, exact 1–8 field levels, comparator and explicit text/finite-number/boolean/null literal

primary.label: Save draft changes
primary.operation: Original updateDraft and exact own-request Activity receipt in one transaction; current node/type/revision/publication/update preconditions.

secondary: Check the exact original save request
Open the existing Advanced editor with the selected Native node

canonicalReadDomains: Native workflow/revisions/node registry, source ownership, verified account, current read/edit grants and write-role fence
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Original workflow updateDraft; strict selected-node changes only, unchanged active revision and no test/publication/run/grant.
systemWork.authorityEffect: No permission, approval or runtime authority is inferred from a draft change.
systemWork.asyncWork: Bounded current read and transactional CAS save; one original request locator precedes POST.
systemWork.receipt: Original request/revision IDs, version and changed flag. No copied name/config/prose in its Activity receipt.

states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: An empty revision means no steps in that revision, not a tested process.
states.partial: Oversized, duplicate, cyclic or dangling-connection flows show flow unavailable with no truncated topology.
states.stale: Hide retained private data during background rechecks and live authority/privacy/version invalidations; a new query epoch rejects late prior responses.
states.validation_error: Associate each invalid name, duration, approval or condition field with a specific correction and a linked, focused error summary. Refuse before persisting a locator or sending POST.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Suppress retained private data and unavailable controls; do not infer additional grants from profile or navigation.
states.recovering: Retain only exact company/account/workflow/kind/request identity. GET the Original receipt; never replace an unknown save with a fresh request.
states.success: Only the confirmed Original draft receipt permits a saved-version claim. It does not publish or start work.

navigation.back: Return to the current Native workflow review.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Back without saving; private inputs remain only in component memory. Browser storage contains scoped request identity only.
navigation.resume: Re-read current account/source/version. Unconfirmed save recovery survives rollout closure; no automatic POST.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Current authorized selected-node name and allowlisted wait/approval/guided-condition configuration
dataCollected: Original canonical draft values and body-free Native request receipt
sensitiveFields: Private draft names/approval prose/configuration are excluded from logs, analytics and browser storage; every private source keeps its own reader policy
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Whole Native workflow namespace is private. Background issue diagnostics mask the editor referer path, including customer-defined node IDs.

functional: Verify one separate draft under concurrent exact retries, unchanged immutable active graph/branches, strict node/config binding, stale/type/foreign/viewer denial, historical recovery with rollout closed, late-verification rollback and no grant/run/publication effect.
Verify lost acknowledgement/reload causes only exact receipt GET, current-account/Source fences reject late replies, and source/version conflicts require current review.
Full trigger/graph/condition/tool/access/approval-policy editing, conversation graph proposals, broader test modes and remaining lifecycle qualification stay open.
accessibility: Verify visible labels, heading/error/receipt focus, keyboard, EN/DA 390px layout and automated main-region axe on built source; manual AT/200–400% zoom remains open.
securityPrivacy: Verify no raw prose/configuration in request recovery storage, audit, generic HTTP/crash or background referer diagnostics; current native source and account authority remain required.
usability: Representative exploratory and preregistered confirmatory Human evidence is still required; controlled software fixtures do not satisfy it.
